name: C#
description: C# on .NET (CoreCLR): compiled to IL, then tiered JIT-compiled with dynamic PGO, with a generational garbage collector.

variants.name: dotnet build -c Release
variants.description: Release build, default runtime settings (tiered compilation, dynamic PGO, concurrent workstation GC).
variants.build: export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1; P={bin}.proj; mkdir -p $P && cp {harness}/Harness.cs $P/ && cp {src}/Program.cs $P/Problem.cs && sed "s/@TFM@/net$(dotnet --version | cut -d. -f1,2)/" /repo/languages/csharp/app.csproj > $P/app.csproj && cd $P && dotnet build -c Release -o {bin} -v q -nologo

variants.name: DOTNET_TieredCompilation=0
variants.description: Every method is fully optimised on its first call: slower start-up, no tier-0 phase.
variants.build: export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1 DOTNET_NOLOGO=1; P={bin}.proj; mkdir -p $P && cp {harness}/Harness.cs $P/ && cp {src}/Program.cs $P/Problem.cs && sed "s/@TFM@/net$(dotnet --version | cut -d. -f1,2)/" /repo/languages/csharp/app.csproj > $P/app.csproj && cd $P && dotnet build -c Release -o {bin} -v q -nologo
